title: Recall: Require the operations a generic algorithm uses
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

where.clue: Write the where clause requiring the generic type T to implement total ordering followed by implicit copying, in that order. Use the standard trait names and omit the function body.

select.clue: Given left and right of type &T where T implements Ord + Copy, write an if expression returning a copied T: dereference left for ties or when larger, otherwise dereference right. Use >=.
